svg.text: CDC Badge built-in font - complete CP437 map
Every glyph the 6x8 glcdfont can draw. 0x20-0x7E = ASCII, 0x80-0xFF = CP437 high half, 0x01-0x1F = pictographs (UI_ICON_*, tinted).
Pixel-accurate from glcdfont - NOT the GFX fonts. Pink = control byte the text renderer eats (0x0A/0x0D); shown from the bitmap only.
UI_ICON_* names (byte passed as a list / context-menu item icon)
